purpose: Defines what an error is, how to classify it, how to treat causes, and the criteria for adding values that distinguish errors, across exit codes, agent return values, requirement error cases and API codes.
summary: Purpose: stop unbounded growth of error values that do not change the receiver behavior
Definition of an error as an event that stops the intended flow, separate from its cause
Non-errors: things that can be judged are decisions, not errors
Classification into recoverable and unrecoverable (fatal) errors
Recovery means are not limited to retry; failure to recover must be reported
Causes: bug, failure, user input or environment, with responsible parties
Bugs must not occur at runtime; no dedicated values or recovery paths per cause
Questions to ask before adding an error value
tasks: Designing error handling and exit codes for scripts
Writing error case sections in requirements
Reviewing error handling for swallowed errors or needless values
Deciding whether to add a new error value or classification
title: エラーの定義・分類・原因
